title: SDK v2 beta: partner pilot orchestration, delta release notes, and localized sample scaffolding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: run a 3-week beta partner pilot for SDK v2 that validates combined surface changes (streaming + function-calling + structured output) and ships production-ready deltas in the public release notes and localized sample kits. Objectives: 1) Validate developer ergonomics for chained streaming + function calls with structured outputs; 2) Lock delta release notes and migration guide between v1 and v2; 3) Deliver localized samples (en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP) and a partner onboarding runbook; 4) Confirm telemetry/metric names and rollout canaries for error spike detection.
deliverables: Migration guide + code snippets (streaming, function-calling, structured)
Telemetry dashboard + alert rules for pilot
acceptance_criteria: Public release notes delta reviewed and approved by eng/docs/design
Three pilot partners have completed onboarding and sent feedback surveys
Samples merged into sdks/samples repo with CI smoke tests
No blocking telemetry alerts in 72-hour canary window
Migration guide covers 95% of top-10 support questions identified in alpha testing
